parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set.

parameters.name: BackupStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

*   **Success**
*   **Failed**

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

> The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

> The default value is **30**.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-detached-backups --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --backup-id 3270000 --backup-status Success --backup-mode Automated --start-time 2021-03-01T16:00Z --end-time 2021-03-15T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeDetachedBackups --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2021-03-15T16:00Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Automated --StartTime '2021-03-01T16:00Z' --BackupId 3270000 --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupStatus Success
